entries.prompt: Technical texture map, not a photograph. Rebuild the exact CHARACTER of the referenced tangled Voil Trend textile as an OPACITY / COVERAGE map. Solid PURE WHITE yarn filaments on a solid PURE BLACK background. Black means open air. Extremely numerous fine, thin, irregular curly and crimped interconnected yarn strands with thousands of small tangled loops and diagonal crossing supporting strands. Preserve chaotic fine curls and varying cell sizes from reference. NO gray cloth substrate; ALL space between individual yarn strands is BLACK including spaces within tangled clusters. White pixels only where an actual yarn crosses. Antialias in gray along thin strand edges only. Many tiny pores plus fewer larger irregular pores. Approximately 65 percent white yarn coverage 35 percent black gaps, organically nonuniform. Must look like a dense interwoven web of fine curled filaments, not a solid sheet punched with circular holes, not crochet lace, no regular grid. All threads thin but clearly resolved. Single seamless square technical tile, full bleed, flat orthographic, no depth/shadows/lighting/folds/text/border. Output grayscale RGB, black opaque background (NOT transparent).
